FILE2FILE / THE PERSON BEHIND IT

Hi, I’m Cınar.

I’m a student who enjoys programming, Linux, and science. I like learning how things work and building tools I can actually use.

A project I’m working on.

File2File brings different conversion tools into one desktop workflow. The idea is practical: choose a file, choose a compatible format, and keep the conversion on your own computer.

It’s still a project I’m improving. Some formats need extra setup, some conversions lose detail, and there will be things to fix. I’d rather explain those limits clearly and keep making the app more useful.

Learning by building.

I’m interested in the details behind the interface: how files are handled, why a conversion fails, and how to make the next attempt easier. Working on small, useful projects gives me a way to learn those things.

You’ll find me on GitHub as arajiger500.
